# 1.01
Source: exercism leap
Write a function `leap::is_leap_year(int year)` that returns true when the year is a leap year.
Limits: none.
## Solution
```cpp
#pragma once

namespace leap {

//: Write a function that returns whether the test holds.
bool is_leap_year([[int year]])
{
    //:: Return whether the year is a leap year.
    return [[year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 || year % 400 == 0)]];
}

}  // namespace leap
```
